research_rules: Quest association does not by itself establish regular-finish, Ultimate-Finish, or enemy-drop behavior.
Numerical rates are not promoted from community farming reports.
Conflicting historical sources remain separate until inventory identity and numbering are reconciled.
A reward source may coexist with other acquisition routes and must not overwrite them.
An unresolved trigger uses guarantee_status=unknown rather than implying a random-roll mechanic merely because the reward is not guaranteed.
